[SWS_Ea_00132]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406
⌈If development error detection for the module EA is enabled: the function Ea_Cancel
shall check if the module state is MEMIF_UNINIT. If this is the case, the function Ea_
Cancel shall raise the development error EA_E_UNINIT and return to the caller without
changing any internal variables.⌋
